roles.title: Senior Technical Product Manager, Metrics & Measurement

bullets: Define the metric and data requirements each platform integration must meet, partnering with the product managers who own platform partnerships.
Define what each performance metric means on each platform: reach, impressions, views, engagement rate, completion rate, and platform-specific metrics, and document how each…
Design the cross-platform measurement logic that lets customers compare performance across platforms in a single, trustworthy view.
Specify custom metrics for customers, including the exact calculation and data requirements behind each one.
Write technical specifications for mapping metrics across platform APIs, covering field mapping, refresh cadence, and known limitations.
